title: I Have Decided To Follow Jesus
author: Attributed to Nokseng (Assam); Indian folk melody

lines: I have decided to follow Jesus
I have decided to follow Jesus
I have decided to follow Jesus
No turning back, no turning back.
Though no one joins me still I will follow
Though no one joins me still I will follow
Though no one joins me still I will follow
No turning back, no turning back.
The world behind me still I will follow
The world behind me still I will follow
The world behind me still I will follow
No turning back, no turning back.
Do take the whole world, but give me Jesus
Do take the whole world, but give me Jesus
Do take the whole world, but give me Jesus
No turning back, no turning back.
